what_happened: The job "Reuse passing CI result by governed fingerprint on landing" (20261025-034731-2am0) failed in the producer stage. The producer hit its fixed 1800-second deadline before finishing. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria, no blocker or major findings and no failed checks. It records no partial result and no last activity, so nothing was delivered and we cannot tell where the time went.
cause: The producer stage has one fixed wall-clock limit, no progress signal, no early stop and no partial result, so a timeout is a bare failure that discards all work. Nothing before dispatch estimates whether the job fits in one run. This job touches landing, CI result reuse and a fingerprint, which spans several places, and the same landing-area work has already timed out and failed planning on this branch. The retry has no memory of earlier attempts. The event holds no producer log, so a timeout carries no diagnosis.
prevention: Make the producer stage report progress and keep partial work. It should write a checkpoint (files changed, last command, last test run) at intervals. On deadline, it should record that checkpoint as a timeout result separate from a real failure. Add a pre-dispatch size check that requires the plan to name the files and tests it touches and refuses or splits a job too big for one run. Let a retry start from the kept checkpoint and the earlier failure notes.
proposed_request: Make a producer timeout recoverable and diagnosable. When the producer reaches its deadline, Athena must record a "timed out" result that is distinct from a failure. It must keep the working-copy diff and a short activity log (last commands, last test run, files touched) with the job. `athena retry` on such a job must start from the kept diff and log and say so in the job record. Before dispatching a code job, check the plan's listed files and tests against a size bound and refuse or split the job if it is over. Demonstrate with a producer run that is forced to exceed its deadline: the job shows timed out with the partial diff and log kept, and a retry resumes from them. Then re-queue "Reuse passing CI result by governed fingerprint on landing" as the next job.
